value.message: Town of Oakville runs Learn to Swim - Preschool (Levels A-E) for ages 3-5 - their site says. Fall registration opens Aug 11 at 7am, browsable online from Aug 4; no price posted yet. I could not get into their page today for more, and YMCA of Oakville also lists preschool swim lessons. I'll keep watching and text you when more details are up.
